priorityDefinition.P0: Resolve before claiming the targeted integrated workflow ready

gaps.operation: bulk/import/export/clone/delete/custom views
gaps.documented: Broad ERP feature proposals exist; full operation-level parity is not accepted. See erpSpecPaths and per-manual documentation status.
gaps.implementation: Supplier/item/request/order/receive draft readers and scoped single-record commands exist; a reusable rendered toolbar is not a server-backed batch/import/export.
gaps.missing: No named import/clone/bulk mutation/export/custom-view routes in inspected item, PR, PO, receive and vendor route maps; preserved ERP records prefer cancellation or retirement over hard delete.
gaps.acceptance: Typed scoped import/export, stable field mapping, limited batch commands and private end-to-end tests; irreversible deletion policy decided explicitly.
gaps.nextMilestone: Define one bounded shared batch/export surface per entity, with permission/PII review.
gaps.interpretation: Functional/workflow priority, not a confirmed exploitable security defect. Missing proof is distinguished from missing source in the implementation/missing fields.

gaps.operation: module preferences and user-configurable fields

gaps.implementation: Typed fields, fixed exact-amount codecs, category/method policy versions and selected module editors exist; this is narrower than arbitrary metadata/preferences.
gaps.missing: Manual quantity precision, duplicate names, numbering, arbitrary status, custom fields/rules/actions and template preferences are broader than typed ERP policy/version records.
gaps.acceptance: Published typed policies with owner approval, schema/validation/migration and UI evidence for chosen preferences.
gaps.nextMilestone: Prioritize concrete requested preferences, not a general script/custom-field engine.
gaps.interpretation: Functional/workflow priority, not a confirmed exploitable security defect. Missing proof is distinguished from missing source in the implementation/missing fields.

gaps.interpretation: Functional/workflow priority, not a confirmed exploitable security defect. Missing proof is distinguished from missing source in the implementation/missing fields.
